### Borea v0.6.13

A patch release for KSA 2026.11.10.5801. Update with "Update now" on the Home banner, or with `borea update-self`.

[Website](https://ksamodding.github.io/Borea/) | [Discord](https://discord.gg/nt4fK4QuTz) | [Content index](https://github.com/KSAModding/content-index) | [Source and issues](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea)

#### Game build 2026.11.10.5801

- The 3D preview, the stills and the covers of vehicles read the part files of the new game build, and still read those of older builds, so an instance that keeps an older build shows its vehicles as before.
- A vehicle saved on one build and opened with an instance on the other build shows placeholders for the parts whose ids the game renamed, because the game itself refuses such a vehicle too.

#### Mod loaders

- When the game stops under a mod loader other than StarMap, Borea shows the general crash text and blames no mod. Nothing changes for StarMap.
- The listing editor proposes the mod loader whose table the mod's `mod.toml` has.

Full changelog: [v0.6.12...v0.6.13](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea/compare/v0.6.12...v0.6.13)
